backend/main.mo: Main actor for the EduBatch platform implementing blob storage, role-based access control, batch/video CRUD, and user profile management with data migration support on upgrade.
backend/migration.mo: Data migration module that transforms the old actor state (batches + videos) to the new state shape by adding an empty userProfiles map.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping three implemented features (MP4 upload, admin access gating, and MP4 video playback) to their relevant source files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document containing one-line summaries of all frontend source files, serving as a reference index for the project's frontend structure.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS entry point defining OKLCH-based design tokens for light and dark modes including colors, radius, chart, and sidebar variables.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the React app, mounting the root div and loading the main TSX module for the EduBatch Video Platform.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React app component that sets up TanStack Router with four routes (home, category, video player, admin) wrapped in a shared layout with NavigationBar, Footer, and Toaster.
frontend/src/components/BatchManagementS: Admin UI component for creating, editing, and deleting course batches with an inline form, category selector, batch grid, and delete confirmation dialogs.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Site footer displaying brand info, category navigation links, platform links, copyright, and a caffeine.ai attribution with UTM tracking.
frontend/src/components/NavigationBar.ts: Renders a sticky top navigation bar with links for class categories (6–12) and NEET, a logo, and an admin button shown only to admin users. Includes a responsive mobile hamburger menu.
frontend/src/components/VideoCard.tsx: Displays a single video as a clickable card with thumbnail, title, subject, and category badge, linking to the video detail page.
frontend/src/components/VideoListAdmin.t: Admin component that lists all uploaded videos in a grid with thumbnail, metadata, batch name, and a delete button with confirmation dialog.
Admin form for uploading a video by either providing a URL or selecting an MP4 file, with fields for title, subject, category, batch, and thumbnail URL, including upload progress tracking.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor using the current Internet Identity, initializing admin access control if an admin token is present in URL params. Invalidates dependent queries whenever the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an Internet Identity authentication context and provider, exposing login/logout functions, identity state, and login status via a React context backed by the DFINITY AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for all backend operations including initialize, admin check, and full CRUD for batches and videos using the actor pattern.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS file that imports Google Fonts, sets up Tailwind directives, and defines CSS custom properties for a warm amber/deep teal color palette in both light and dark modes.
frontend/src/lib/utils.ts: Utility module providing a Tailwind class merger, category label/color mappings, a slug-to-Category converter, and a random ID generator.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider wrapping the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/AdminDashboard.tsx: Admin-only dashboard page that verifies admin privileges, shows batch/video stats, and provides tabbed sections for batch management, video upload, and video listing.
frontend/src/pages/CategoryPage.tsx: Page that displays videos and batches filtered by a URL category slug, grouping videos by batch with loading skeletons and empty states.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Home page featuring a hero banner, class category grid, and NEET section; auto-initializes seed data if no NEET batches exist and displays batch/video counts.
frontend/src/pages/VideoPlayerPage.tsx: React page that displays a video player supporting YouTube embeds, backend-stored MP4 file references, and plain video URLs, along with video metadata (title, description, batch info, category, date).
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routes, with helpers for persisting values to/from sessionStorage and cleaning sensitive params from the URL.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining dark mode, custom fonts, OKLCH-based color tokens, border radii, shadows, background gradients, and accordion keyframe animations with typography and container-query plugins.
project_state.json: Project state manifest tracking the EduBatch Video Platform's existing features (MP4 upload, admin gating, video player detection) and pending feature requests (admin role system, MP4 upload for admins, deployer as initial admin).
